concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-nab-overview]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted direct-link portal for recipients with at least one NAB-funded merchant account, routing to account-tailored articles and preserving business-bank timeline and banking-partner variability; not NAB-provisioning, region, currency, independent current NAB policy, linked-target behavior, or proof every account has that funding setup
